intro.text: For over 40 years, we have been developing machine design that turns market leaders into market leaders. With more than 210 international design awards and projects for companies like Liebherr, Arburg and WashTec, we are the specialist for capital goods that don't just work – they sell.

problem.title: WHY MACHINE DESIGN MATTERS
problem.subtitle: First impressions count – even for machines.
problem.paragraph1: In the capital goods sector, buyers make decisions worth millions. Before technical data is compared, the design has already made its impact. A machine that radiates quality, conveys precision and inspires trust shortens sales cycles and justifies premium prices.
problem.paragraph2: Professional machine design is not cosmetics. It is a strategic tool that strengthens your market position, differentiates your brand and supports your sales.

leistungen.title: OUR SERVICES
leistungen.subtitle: Holistic machine design from a single source

maschinenverkleidung.title: Machine Enclosures
maschinenverkleidung.text: From the first sketch to production-ready design: We develop machine enclosures that combine protection, function and aesthetics. Our designs consider maintenance access, cable routing and thermal requirements – while creating a distinctive product identity.

hmi.title: HMI Design
hmi.text: The interface between human and machine determines productivity and satisfaction. We design user interfaces that work intuitively, prevent errors and empower your operators. From touchscreen interfaces to physical control panels.

corporate.title: Corporate Industrial Design
corporate.text: A machine is a brand ambassador. We develop design languages that run through your entire product portfolio – from small devices to large systems. Recognizable, consistent and unmistakably your brand.

anlagen.title: Plant Design
anlagen.text: Complex production systems place special demands on design. We structure visual hierarchies, define color codes for safety and orientation and create order in chaos – without restricting technical function.

referenzen.title: REFERENCES
referenzen.subtitle: Machine design for world market leaders
referenzen.text: Our clients are not startups experimenting with design. They are established market leaders who know that excellent machine design is a competitive advantage. Together we have won over 210 international design awards.

faq.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
faq.subtitle: Answers to your questions about machine design

items.question: What does professional machine design cost?
items.answer: The costs for machine design vary depending on project scope, complexity and desired services. A typical project starts at a mid five-figure amount. However, what matters is the ROI: Professional design shortens sales cycles, justifies premium prices and differentiates you from the competition. In a non-binding initial consultation, we clarify your specific needs.

items.question: How long does a machine design project take?
items.answer: The project duration depends on the scope. A machine enclosure can be realized in 3-4 months, a complete corporate industrial design for a product family takes 6-12 months. We work with defined milestones and keep you continuously informed about progress.

items.question: When should design be involved in the development process?
items.answer: As early as possible. The later design is involved, the more limited the possibilities and the more expensive changes become. Ideally, we start parallel to the technical concept phase. This way we can coordinate design and engineering from the beginning.

items.question: Does Design Tech also work with smaller companies?
items.answer: Yes. Our clients range from medium-sized machine builders to global corporations. What matters is not company size, but ambition: If you want to become or remain a market leader, we are the right partner.

items.question: What sets Design Tech apart from other design agencies?
items.answer: Three things: First, our 40-year specialization in machine design – no one in Germany has comparable experience in the capital goods sector. Second, over 210 international design awards as proof of quality. Third, our Design to Success® methodology that strategically links design with your business model.

items.question: Can we implement the design internally or do we need construction data?
items.answer: We deliver exactly what you need. This can range from concept sketches to 3D data to production-ready construction documents. Many clients appreciate that we speak the language of engineering and develop designs that can be manufactured economically.

branchen.title: INDUSTRIES
branchen.subtitle: Specialized in capital goods
branchen.text: Our focus is on mechanical engineering and related industries. We understand the technical requirements, know the manufacturing processes and speak the language of your engineers.

prozess.title: DESIGN TO SUCCESS®
prozess.subtitle: Our proven methodology for measurable success
prozess.text: We don't start with the product – we start with your business model. This is the only way to create machine design that works in sales, differentiates in the market and is accepted within the company. Our method has been proven for decades and has received multiple awards.

erfahrung.title: 40+ Years Experience
erfahrung.text: Exclusively specialized in machine design since 1984. No other design company in Germany has comparable depth in the capital goods sector.

awards.title: 210+ Design Awards
awards.text: Red Dot, iF, German Design Award – our work is internationally recognized. Not as an end in itself, but as proof of design quality that convinces your customers.

kunden.title: Market Leaders as Clients
kunden.text: Liebherr, Arburg, WashTec, Waldmann – we work with companies that lead in their markets. And they know why.

standort.title: Location Germany
standort.text: Ammerbuch near Tübingen – in the heart of German mechanical engineering. Short distances to your development departments, personal contact instead of offshore communication.

cta.title: LET'S TALK ABOUT YOUR PROJECT
cta.text: Every successful machine design starts with a conversation. In a non-binding video call, we learn about your challenges and show how we can support you.
